name: TagInput
summary: Turns typed text into removable tags: Enter or a comma ends a tag, a pasted list splits into tags, repeats and a maximum are refused and said, and a check can mark a tag invalid while keeping it. Not for choosing from a known list (use a Combobox when it lands) or for one value (TextField).
a11y: A Field: the label names the one text input, which stays the only Tab stop; hint and messages are linked. The tags are a list before it, each a Chip with a Remove button named "Remove" plus the tag. Adding, removing and refusing are announced politely. An invalid tag says why in the message line, not in colour alone.

keys.action: add the typed text; Backspace or Left in an empty box: move to the last tag; Left / Right: move between tags and back to the box; Delete / Backspace on a tag: remove it and keep focus nearby

props.name: label
props.description: What the tags are, a short noun phrase: "Labels", "Recipients".

props.name: value
props.description: The tags, in the order added.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every change: a tag added, removed or cleared.

props.name: hint
props.description: How to add: "Press Enter or type a comma after each label." Said once, under the box.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An example, never an instruction. Hidden once a tag is added.

props.name: separators
props.description: What ends a tag as it's typed, besides Enter. Default a comma. Pasted lists also split on line breaks and tabs.

props.name: max
props.description: The most tags; past it the box says so and refuses more.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Keep a tag that is already there (compared without case). Default false: a repeat is refused and said.

props.name: validate
props.description: Checks a tag: return what is wrong with it to keep it but mark it invalid (an unknown address), or nothing.

props.name: clearable
props.description: A Clear all button at the end of the box while there are tags.

props.name: size
props.description: The box height on the field scale: `s` 36, `normal` 44, `l` 56 px; chips follow (s 24, normal 32, l 40).

props.name: necessity
props.description: Marks "(optional)" or "(required)"; fields are required by default.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong with the set as a whole and how to fix it.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the tags without remove buttons; still focusable.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Nothing can change and it needn't be read. Prefer `readOnly`, or say why in the hint.
